en: An old black‑and‑white postcard showing a garden and lawn in front of a modest, classical villa partially covered by trees and ivy. Flower beds border the grass, and a small pavilion or conservatory stands on the right. A child in light clothing stands in the middle foreground. Along the right margin there is vertical printed text in Dutch describing a guesthouse named "Pension 'Klein Stockenhoff'" and its proprietor G. J. Entink in Beek near Nijmegen.
